memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of an already taught relationship only; no calculation, practical-performance or ordinary-content mastery is certified.

wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the previously taught Henderson–Hasselbalch relationship between pH, pKa and the conjugate-base to weak-acid concentration ratio, together with its connection to such a buffer, using the associated flashcard.
